name: antevo-build
description: Build your own tools on seven Antevo engines. Startup Launch Intelligence tries your candidate names until one is clear and builds a 90-day plan. Company Due Diligence checks a company before you sign or pay. Supply Chain Watch checks a supply route leg by leg before the next order. M&A Intelligence maps a niche and reads a shortlist before any approach, with the deal climate. Real Estate Acquisition reads a property purchase before you sign: the seller, the deposit, the market and the mortgage. Family Office reads the week against what a family owns and relies on. Market Entry reads a new country before you open there: the name, demand, the trade and export rules and the currency. Each lists what to settle with the official links and says what each finding means. Every figure dated; what was not checked says so; options to consider, never advice.
